purpose: Model comparison over bounded edits of existing public starters; no full-site generation or human acceptance asserted.
dataPolicy: Fictional public starter briefs only. No customer uploads, secrets, private content, real provider output or purchase artifacts.

cases.prompt: Shape this public service-business starter for Harbor Workshop, a home-repair planning service. Make the hero specific and welcoming, use a modern font and a calm navy palette with a warm accent. Keep the existing sections and contact destination. Do not invent prices, credentials, reviews or connected services.

ops.value:
A clear plan for
your home repairs.
Harbor Workshop helps you plan the next steps for everyday home repairs. Start with a conversation about your project.

instructionFidelity: Hero identifies home-repair planning and a conversation as the next step.
No invented credentials, price, guarantee or testimonial.
renderedMobile: Headline and CTA are legible at 1440 and 390 CSS pixels.
Keep readable foreground/accent contrast and no horizontal overflow.
preservation: Section order, links, artwork, glass settings and all non-hero copy remain unchanged.
